name: vhs-c073383b-blind19-ots
instr:
# vhs-regen

This tool turns a hand-written script of terminal steps into an animation, and can also turn a session someone captured at a real terminal back into such a script. Both halves now give wrong answers, and so does almost every question about which color scheme to use. Nothing about the file format changed and nothing about the scripts changed. The repository has received 19 separate undocumented edits.

Start with simply writing a script and having it read back. Every figure in a file is now unrecognizable as a number — a font size of 42, a padding of 5, a sleep of 1, a duration written as 500ms or .5s — so practically every line carrying a figure is misread. A line set aside as a note with a hash comes back short, the first character after the marker swallowed, so a note written with a leading space arrives with that space gone. A wait line whose pattern is written between slashes yields the wrong pattern text, and patterns holding a backslash before a slash, or a doubled backslash, come out especially garbled.

Asking for key presses goes wrong in its own ways. A bare word containing a capital A is no longer read as a single word — Alt is torn in two at that character — so every line mentioning it is misunderstood from the start. A line pairing Alt with a single key, such as Alt+. or Alt+L or Alt+i, no longer produces an Alt step carrying that key as its argument. A count written after a key name is ignored: Down 2, Backspace@0.1 5 or Enter 3 each behave as a sin
